observations: Photo 0 shows a yellow cooking gas cylinder with a top valve/handle area and a label/markings on the body; cylinder has visible dents/scratches and some rust/marks around the valve area.
Photo 1 shows a blue cooking gas cylinder with the top valve/handle area; the valve opening/guard and body show wear and scuffs.
Photo 2 shows another view of a blue cooking gas cylinder top valve/neck; the valve appears intact but the cylinder body shows dents/scratches.

claims.evidence: Photos show cooking gas cylinders but do not clearly show the 12.5kg marking/weight rating or a readable cylinder specification.

risks.risk: Cylinder weight/size may not be 12.5kg (could be smaller/larger), which changes value and refill pricing.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the cylinder’s stamped/printed weight rating (e.g., “12.5kg”) and/or the cylinder serial/spec plate.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unknown-size used cooking gas cylinder (worst case for value: not confirmed 12.5kg).

risks.risk: Condition/safety: dents, corrosion, or valve damage could make it unsafe or harder to refill/exchange.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the valve assembly and the entire body for dents/corrosion, plus a photo showing the cylinder base ring and any impact points.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used cylinder with possible wear (worst case: treat as not guaranteed to be in exchange-ready condition).

risks.risk: Refill/exchange eligibility: some cylinders may be expired, unregistered, or not accepted by certain suppliers.
risks.proof: Photo of the cylinder’s identification/registration markings (serial number/owner mark) and any visible inspection/expiry stamps.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed exchangeable (worst case: buyer may need to pay for revalidation/refill without exchange benefits).

risks.risk: Quantity ambiguity: photos show both yellow and blue cylinders; seller may be offering one or multiple cylinders.
risks.proof: Confirm how many cylinders are included in the sale (one or both colors) with a single photo showing the exact items included.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the minimum quantity shown/assumed (worst case: only one cylinder is included).

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the cylinder marking that states the weight (confirm “12.5kg”).
Close-up of the valve/neck area (front and side) showing no damage/leaks (if possible, a simple leak-check video).
Photo of the cylinder serial/ID and any inspection/expiry stamps.
Confirm whether the sale includes the yellow cylinder, the blue cylinder, or both (and how many total).
response.reason: The photos confirm cooking gas cylinders but do not clearly verify the key pricing driver (12.5kg rating) and there’s ambiguity about which cylinder(s) are included. Without that proof, a correct worst-case price can’t be set confidently.
